$comment: Single source of truth for Storybook hierarchy. scripts/storybook-lint.mjs enforces it; .storybook/Introduction.mdx renders from it. Change this file, not the titles.

Overview.blurb: Landing pages — this introduction, the token swatch grid, the type scale, and the packaged widgets.

Shell.blurb: The application chrome the generated app boots into.

Layout.blurb: Sidebar, topbar, and the nav pieces inside them.

Content.blurb: The page frame and its building blocks.

Motion.blurb: Entrance choreography. Everything that arrives on screen arrives through one of these.

Illustrations.blurb: The animated scenes on the Generating screen, one per course-building stage, drawn from live job data.

Pages.blurb: Whole routes, each with its empty and populated states.
